subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A1638/26 NOTAMR A4492/25 Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2605210800  C) 2612311600  E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026).
AND TURKISH NOTAM REQUEST MESSAGE 250829 LTAAYNYX DEC 2025.
REF (B) GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE 291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025.
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (A) TURKISH NOTAM
A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS
TO TURKISH MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY
COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE
AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE
AIR TRAFFIC IS THE HELLENIC CAA THROUGH THE ATS UNITS.
AS HAS BEEN CONSISTENTLY NOTED IN THE PAST, AND WITH THE REF (B)
291240 LGACYAYC DEC 2025 GREEK COORDINATION MESSAGE TO TURKEY, PARTS
OF THE AREA MENTIONED IN TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EUECYIYN MAY
2026) OVERLAP AREAS OF NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY OF GREECE.
FURTHERMORE, THE TURKISH REQUEST ENTAILS LONG-TERM RESERVATION
OF AIRSPACE CONTRARY TO THE RELEVANT ICAO RECOMMENDATIONS.
CONSEQUENTLY, THE AREA AS REQUESTED IS NOT AVAILABLE.
FOR THE ABOVE MENTIONED REASONS THE TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26 (200935 EU
ECYIYN MAY END PART 1 OF 2
A1638/26 NOTAMR A4492/25 Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2605210800  C) 2612311600  E) 2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE TO ATHINAI FIR. END PART 2 OF 2
